purpose: Define each named port-bound network/service listener as an explicit stable identity separate from port, address, protocol route and runtime socket.

topics.name: Network Listener Identity
topics.purpose: Define each named port-bound network/service listener as an explicit stable identity separate from port, address, protocol route and runtime socket.

semantics.identity_rule: Each listener instance has an explicit stable logical identity.
semantics.binding_rule: Port/address/interface/transport bindings are configuration attached to listener identity.
semantics.runtime_rule: Runtime socket/process identity is distinct from listener identity.
semantics.port_rule: Port number is never the semantic listener identity.
semantics.state_rule: Configured/enabled/running state is separate from identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Listener existence or reachability grants no application authority.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

hard_gates.condition: port number used as listener identity
runtime socket reused as canonical identity
